app ModelRuleActivation
Given
 InvariantOnly { label:text="valid" }
 LockedOnly { label:text="valid" }
 policy InvariantOnly read=public
 policy LockedOnly read=public
 ## Activation must refuse rules until their canonical execution join exists.
 invariant InvariantOnly: row.label!="forbidden"
 lock LockedOnly fields=label
When
 crud InvariantOnly by=public fields=label
 crud LockedOnly by=public fields=label
Then
